# WeWatch

> WeWatch (wewatch.uz) is a free watch party app for watching videos together with friends in real time. One person presses play or pause — it happens for everyone at the same time. Works with YouTube, VK Video, Rutube, Uzmove and any website through a built-in browser. Available on iOS, Android and Web. Made by tezcode.dev (Tashkent, Uzbekistan). Interface languages: Russian, Uzbek, English.

## What WeWatch does

- **Synchronized watching (watch party):** Everyone in a room sees the exact same frame in real time. Pause, play and seek are synced for all participants (drift kept within about ±2 seconds using clock synchronization).
- **Cross-platform sync:** One participant can be on an iPhone, another on Android, another in a desktop web browser — they all watch in the same synced room. This cross-device watch party is a core differentiator.
- **Built-in browser:** Open YouTube, VK Video, Rutube, Uzmove, Cinerama or any other video site inside the app and watch it together — no need for the site to support co-watching.
- **Live chat and emoji reactions:** Text chat and floating emoji reactions inside every room.
- **Friends, Battle mode, achievements:** Add friends, compete on who watches more (Battle), and unlock achievements.
- **Free:** WeWatch is fully free. Sign up with a phone number. No paid plan.

## Key facts

- Website: https://wewatch.uz
- Platforms: iOS (App Store), Android (Google Play), Web (browser)
- Price: Free
- Supported sources: YouTube, VK Video, Rutube, Uzmove, Cinerama, and other sites via built-in browser
- Languages: Russian (ru), Uzbek (uz), English (en)
- Made by: tezcode.dev, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Category: Entertainment / social co-watching (analogous to Rave)

## Common questions WeWatch answers

- How to watch videos together with friends online → download WeWatch, open the built-in browser, find a video, create a room, share the invite link. Everyone watches synchronously.
- Can I watch a movie online with my friend → yes; find the movie in the built-in browser, create a room, send the link. Pause and seek are synced for both of you.
- How to watch YouTube together at the same time → supported through the built-in browser; pause and seek sync for all.
- What to do when a friend is far away → create a watch party and share the link; distance does not matter.
- Can one person be on phone and another on the website → yes, WeWatch syncs across all platforms in one room.
- Is WeWatch free → yes, fully free.
